description: Replace a plan's priced lines (owner or office), and optionally its tax rate. An agent can only propose the lines: they wait until the owner or office confirms them with maintenance.confirmPrice. A person who is the owner or office writes them now. Applies from the next term's invoice; invoices already made keep their price.

kind.description: item (default), fee (trip charge, disposal, card fee) or discount. For a discount, enter the amount off as a positive unit_price_minor.

taxable.description: Counts toward tax when the quote or invoice has a tax rate. Default true.

tax_rate_id.description: Tax rate each term charges. Leave out to keep the plan's current rate; null for no tax.

name: maintenance_setPrice
